title: Thorium abundance
method: Lunar Prospector GRS thorium map (half-degree). Bilinear resampling of the 0.5° simple-cylindrical product (longitude wraps at ±180°). True footprint ~60–150 km: finer grids add no detail.

sources.name: Lunar Prospector GRS/NS special products (0.5°)
sources.citation: Lunar Prospector Spectrometer Team, NASA PDS Geosciences Node
